# comi

> A morning reading for this place, this person, and this day. Made by COMI SDN. BHD.

comi is an iOS app. It reads a person’s birth chart, the character of the day, and a place they are standing in, and holds those together before the day gets loud. The guidance is classical, and it is held lightly. A score is a reading for the morning, not a prediction of what will happen.

You can begin with the day. A home, a gate facing, and a room scan can come later.

## Pages

- [Home](https://comidaily.com/): The product in one page. Person, day, and place.
- [Privacy](https://comidaily.com/privacy.html): What COMI SDN. BHD. collects, what it does not do, and how to delete an account.

## The three readings

- You: date, time, and city of birth become a chart comi keeps. Each day is read against that chart.
- Today: a direction to face, a measure of the day’s momentum, and a few words for how to meet it.
- Places: a home, an office, or a site. Set which way it faces. That facing sits beside the chart and the year.
